invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of atlas.findRegion with the parsed region name.
parseRegionName(name) produces the argument passed to findRegion, so it should not be null unless allowed by findRegion.
If name is null, parseRegionName(name) may also be null, otherwise it has some string value.
If name is non-null, parseRegionName(name) is likely non-empty as we're searching for a region.
result is always either null or an instance of TextureRegion, as returned by atlas.findRegion.
